name: Playwright MCP
summary: Automate browsers through Playwright's accessibility tree to navigate pages, fill forms, and run end-to-end checks.
description: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server, spawned locally via npx (@playwright/mcp@0.0.86). Interacts with pages through structured accessibility snapshots, so no vision model is needed. Runs a real browser locally, so the client asks for explicit confirmation before installing a stdio server.
author: Microsoft
